attributes.name: Leng Spider
attributes.powers:
Roll 1d6. On a 1, 2, or 3, you may not play spells with the Attack trait.

If undefeated, the damage from the Leng Spider is dealt to a random character. Move to that character's location.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close this location.
